request: Investigate the delay on order ORD-1011.

steps.text: I will look up the order details to see its promised delivery date, status, items, and fulfillment warehouse.
Since the order is marked SHIPPED and is past its promised date, I will check the shipment tracking to determine current status, ETA, and any recorded delay reason.

arguments.summary: Order ORD-1011 is overdue by 2 days. The shipment was dispatched 4 days after the ship-by date, pushing delivery past the promised date; the carrier shows it in transit with ETA 2026-03-17 and no recorded delay reason.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1011 fulfillment_status SHIPPED; promised_delivery_date 2026-03-14; ship_by_date 2026-03-09
get_shipment_status: SHP-5011 Harbor Express tracking HBX-12077 status IN_TRANSIT; dispatch_date 2026-03-13; dispatched_late true with dispatch_days_after_ship_by 4
get_shipment_status: SHP-5011 is_overdue true; days_past_promised_date 2; current_estimated_delivery_date 2026-03-17 (eta_after_promised_date true)
get_shipment_status: SHP-5011 last_event 2026-03-15 at Richmond, VA; days_since_last_event 1; recorded_delay_reason null
arguments.likely_cause: The warehouse handed the order to the carrier 4 days after its ship-by date, resulting in an ETA after the promised delivery date; no carrier delay is recorded.
uncertainties: Whether any minor in-transit factors may further shift the ETA beyond 2026-03-17 is unknown, though tracking shows recent movement.
It is unclear if the promised date was feasible given transit lead times, but the confirmed late dispatch is sufficient to explain the miss.

recommended_actions.details: Inform Wide World Importers that the order is delayed and provide the updated ETA 2026-03-17 per get_shipment_status (SHP-5011, Harbor Express, tracking HBX-12077, status IN_TRANSIT). Explain it is 2 days past the promised date 2026-03-14.

Ask the Atlanta Distribution Center (WH-ATL) to explain why dispatch occurred on 2026-03-13, which is 4 days after the ship-by date 2026-03-09 (get_shipment_status: dispatched_late true, dispatch_days_after_ship_by 4), and to implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
Continue monitoring tracking for SHP-5011 (Harbor Express HBX-12077). Last scan was 2026-03-15 at Richmond, VA with days_since_last_event 1; no carrier delay reason recorded.

arguments.recommendation: Notify the customer of the updated 2026-03-17 ETA and escalate to WH-ATL to address the confirmed late dispatch; continue to monitor tracking until delivery.
